node.title: Re^13: Need sleep walking help
node.author: haukex
node.doctext:
Hi [choroba],

Probably in [mod://Perl::Critic::Policy::InputOutput::ProhibitInteractiveTest] ?

Yes, that was exactly it!

It doesn't say why, but it offers an alternative.

I checked PBP and that's the source ([https://library.oreilly.com/book/9780596001735/perl-best-practices/119.xhtml#interactivity|Chapter 10. I/O, Interactivity]). However, it doesn't really say anything is broken with [doc://-X|-t], just that "-t *ARGV && -t *STDOUT" shouldn't be used to determine if the program is connected to a terminal, as in whether the user can be prompted interactively or not. Interestingly, the recommended alternative, [mod://IO::Interactive], uses -t itself :-)

Regards,
-- Hauke D
